{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = '/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv'
data = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Clean revenue column: remove commas and convert to float
# Also handle the fact that revenue is stored as string with commas
# Convert to float after removing commas
data['revenue_clean'] = data['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Filter out refunded orders and QA orders
# QA orders are defined as having revenue = 999999.99
filtered_data = data[
    (data['status'] == 'completed') & 
    (data['revenue_clean'] != 999999.99)
]

# Group by channel and sum revenue
channel_revenue = filtered_data.groupby('channel')['revenue_clean'].sum()

# Find the channel with the highest total revenue
best_channel = channel_revenue.idxmax()
max_revenue = channel_revenue.max()

channel_revenue, best_channel, max_revenue"}
